rEDMRec：将大型语言模型推理提炼成可编辑的经验记忆以进行推荐rEDMRec: Distilling Large Language Model Reasoning into an Editable Experience Memory for Recommendation

Minh Hoang Nguyen 24C15049@student.hcmus.edu.vn    Tung Le lttung@fit.hcmus.edu.vn    Huy Tien Nguyen ntienhuy@fit.hcmus.edu.vn organization=Faculty of Information Technology, University of Science, city=Ho Chi Minh City, country=Vietnam organization=Vietnam National University, city=Ho Chi Minh City, country=Vietnam
摘要Abstract

大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以通过对用户历史记录和候选项目进行显式推理来提高推荐质量 - 例如，提取用户的偏好或解释为什么一个项目比另一个项目更适合 - 而不是将历史记录直接映射到排名列表。然而，在每个排名请求上重复这种推理的成本很高，而且一旦产生，通常会被消耗一次并丢弃，使其既不能在未来的请求中重复使用，也不能随着用户口味的变化而易于检查或纠正。我们的见解是，如果可以将推理压缩一次到轻量级模型从中检索的紧凑的结构化内存中，则不需要在每次调用时重新生成推理。我们提出了 rEDMRec，它将教师 LLM 的推理提炼成四种类型的、可编辑的体验通道——长期偏好、短期上下文、项目感知和反事实硬否定比较——由 LLM 内存控制器维护，该控制器执行添加/删除/修改/保留操作并通过以下方式细化条目Large language models (LLMs) can improve recommendation quality by reasoning explicitly over user history and candidate items – for example, extracting a user’s preferences or explaining why one item fits better than another – rather than mapping history directly to a ranked list. This reasoning, however, is expensive to repeat on every ranking request and, once produced, is typically consumed once and discarded, leaving it neither reusable across future requests nor easy to inspect or correct as user tastes drift. Our insight is that reasoning does not need to be regenerated at every call if it can instead be compressed once into a compact, structured memory that a lightweight model retrieves from. We propose rEDMRec, which distills a teacher LLM’s reasoning into four typed, editable experience channels – long-term preference, short-term context, item-perception, and counterfactual hard-negative comparisons – maintained by an LLM memory controller that performs Add/Delete/Modify/Keep operations and refines entries viaKK-代理人辩论。然后，轻量级学生 LLM（3B-20B 参数）纯粹通过从该内存中检索来对候选人进行排名，而无需再次调用教师，从而将在线推理成本与推理深度解耦。在 ML-1M、Amazon Beauty、Steam 和 10 个学生主干上，rEDMRec 在每个主干上比零样本、少样本和 RAG 提高了 HR@1，在大多数主干上比 GraphRAG 提高了（例外：Llama 3.1 8B 和 GPT OSS 20B），Impv 高达-agent debate. A lightweight student LLM (3B–20B parameters) then ranks candidates purely by retrieving from this memory, without invoking the teacher again, decoupling online inference cost from reasoning depth. Across ML-1M, Amazon Beauty, and Steam and ten student backbones, rEDMRec improves HR@1 over zero-shot, few-shot, and RAG on every backbone, and over GraphRAG on most backbones (exceptions: Llama 3.1 8B and GPT OSS 20B), with Impv up to13.3%13.3\%与 ML-1M 上的第二最佳基线相比，遵循 RDRec 的相对改进协议vs. the second-best baseline on ML-1M, following the relative-improvement protocol of RDRec(41)。渠道消融表明，短期背景是唯一能够在能力层次上持续提供帮助的渠道，而长期、项目感知和反事实贡献则取决于能力（并且可能会对最优秀的学生产生逆转）；基于辩论的内存优化减少了银行重复. Channel ablations show that short-term context is the only channel that helps consistently across capacity tiers, whereas long-term, item-perception, and counterfactual contributions are capacity-dependent (and can reverse on the strongest students); debate-based memory optimization lowers bank duplication by7.47.4个百分点，同时将下游 HR@1 提高最多percentage points while raising downstream HR@1 by up to+0.029+0.029超过六个优化时期。over six optimization epochs.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地用作推荐系统——通过提示、指令调整、协作信号融合或生成项目预测Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as recommenders – via prompting, instruction tuning, collaborative-signal fusion, or generative item prediction(45; 21; 1; 20; 13)– 最近，作为用户历史和候选项目的明确推理者– and, more recently, as explicit reasoners over user history and candidate items(42)。法学硕士可以提取偏好、判断项目适合度或将候选人与硬否定进行对比，然后使用该推理来指导排名。本文研究了该能力带来的一个具体瓶颈：一旦为用户生成了这样的推理，如何才能将其提供给用户？. An LLM can extract preferences, judge item fit, or contrast a candidate against a hard negative, then use that reasoning to guide ranking. This paper studies a concrete bottleneck that follows from that capability: once such reasoning has been produced for a user, how can it be重复使用reused跨越未来的排名请求，而不是每次都从头开始重新生成？across future ranking requests, rather than regenerated from scratch every time?

推理增强推荐器面临推理深度和推理成本之间的紧张关系。零样本和少样本提示，以及原始交互历史记录的检索增强生成（RAG）Reasoning-augmented recommenders face a tension between reasoning depth and inference cost. Zero-shot and few-shot prompting, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over raw interaction history(16)，成本低廉，但跳过了明确的偏好级别推理，因此在较短的历史记录下排名仍然不透明且脆弱。更接近我们的设置， ReasoningRec, are cheap but skip explicit preference-level reasoning, so ranking remains opaque and brittle under short histories. Closer to our setting, ReasoningRec(2)使用法学硕士教师来综合用户配置文件、项目描述和人类可解释的解释性推理，然后根据这些痕迹进行指令调整较小的模型； R2记录uses a teacher LLM to synthesize user profiles, item descriptions, and human-interpretable explanatory reasoning, then instruction-tunes a smaller model on those traces; R2Rec(55)类似地构建思维交互链，并通过监督微调和强化学习将其内在化；和similarly builds interaction-of-thought chains and internalizes them with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning; andR4R^{4}ec (10)使用反射模型迭代参与者推理，该模型在提供推荐主干之前批评和完善偏好/项目知识。这些行主要将推理视为每个请求或训练时间信号：能力存在于重新生成的轨迹或模型权重中，当新交互到达或低质量推理累积时无法逐项更新，并且修订需要另一个昂贵的推理循环或重新训练，而不是有针对性的内存编辑。相关的蒸馏方法将基本原理或提示压缩到更小的生成器中iterates actor reasoning with a reflection model that critiques and refines preference/item knowledge before feeding a recommendation backbone. These lines treat reasoning primarily as a per-request or training-time signal: competence lives in regenerated traces or model weights, cannot be updated entry-by-entry when new interactions arrive or low-quality reasoning accumulates, and revision requires another costly reasoning loop or retraining rather than a targeted memory edit. Related distillation methods compress rationales or prompts into smaller generators(41; 18)，但仍然将蒸馏后的工件视为固定模型而不是类型库。因此，剩下的挑战是架构上的：保持教师级推理的优势，同时使推理可跨请求重用并可随着时间的推移进行编辑，而无需在底层知识必须改变时重新训练骨干。, yet still treat the distilled artifact as a fixed model rather than as a typed bank. The remaining challenge is therefore architectural: keep the benefit of teacher-level reasoning while making that reasoning reusable across requests and editable over time, without retraining the backbone whenever the underlying knowledge must change.

如图所示As illustrated in Figure1，考虑一个用户的历史记录主要是家庭和动画标题（例如，, consider a user whose history is dominated by family and animation titles (e.g.,玩具总动员Toy Story, 狮子王The Lion King, 怪物史莱克Shrek, 海底总动员Finding Nemo）以及谁必须排名) and who must rank冷冻Frozen反对against黑暗骑士The Dark Knight。如果推荐器只关注明确的项目标题或无差别的历史文本，它就很难揭示这些交互之间的微妙联系——用户始终更喜欢轻松的家庭娱乐而不是黑暗的犯罪——并且没有结构化的地方来存储强负面对比，从而推动. If the recommender focuses solely on explicit item titles or undifferentiated history text, it struggles to surface the subtle connection across these interactions – that the user consistently prefers light family entertainment over dark crime – and has no structured place to store a hard-negative contrast that would push黑暗骑士The Dark Knight当这种模式成立时就会下跌。在这种情况下，潜在偏好不是单个关键字，而是一组类型化的信号：长期品味（稳定的家庭/动画偏好；不喜欢黑暗的犯罪基调）、短期会话上下文（特许经营或好友友好的标题）、基于原因的项目感知down when that pattern holds. In this case, the latent preference is not a single keyword but a typed bundle of signals: long-term taste (stable family/animation preference; dislike of dark crime tone), short-term session context (franchise- or buddy-friendly titles), item-perception that grounds why冷冻Frozen与历史相符，同时matches the history while黑暗骑士The Dark Knight不匹配，以及记录黑暗行动替代方案何时排名更高的反事实。现有的推理增强方法要么根据请求重新生成此类比较，要么将它们吸收到权重中，因此它们无法在未来的排名调用中将这四个信号保留为独立可检索和独立可编辑的内存条目。mismatches, and a counterfactual that records when the dark-action alternative would have ranked higher. Existing reasoning-augmented methods either regenerate such comparisons per request or absorb them into weights, so they cannot keep these four signals as independently retrievable and independently editable memory entries across future ranking calls.

我们通过 rEDMRec 应对这一挑战。基本思想如图所示We address this challenge with rEDMRec. The basic idea is illustrated in Figure1：我们没有要求法学硕士对每个推理调用进行推理和排名，而是使用法学硕士作为: instead of asking an LLM to both reason and rank on every inference call, we use the LLM as a教师推理生成器teacher reasoning generator并将其输出提炼成结构化、可检索和可更新的经验记忆，供轻量级学生在排名时使用。具体来说，教师产生四种类型的经验信号——长期偏好、短期上下文、项目感知和反事实硬否定比较——并且蒸馏适配器将每个信号标准化为通道索引内存条目（前三个通道的向量存储；反事实的混合向量图存储）。推断，一个and distill its outputs into a structured, retrievable, and updatable Experience Memory that a lightweight student consumes at ranking time. Concretely, the teacher produces four typed experience signals – long-term preference, short-term context, item perception, and counterfactual hard-negative comparisons – and a distillation adapter normalizes each signal into a channel-indexed memory entry (vector store for the first three channels; hybrid vector–graph store for counterfactuals). At inference, a冷冻的frozen学生 (3B–20B) 检索顶部-student (3B–20B) retrieves the top-mm每个通道的条目，组成排名提示，并对候选人进行评分，而无需重新调用教师，因此准确性的提高归因于记忆而不是学生参数的适应。剩下的困难是，随着互动的增长，从教师抽取中填满的银行会积累近乎重复和低特异性的条目。受到免培训 GRPO 的启发entries per channel, composes a ranking prompt, and scores candidates without re-invoking the teacher, so accuracy gains are attributable to the memory rather than to student-parameter adaptation. A remaining difficulty is that a bank filled once from teacher extractions accumulates near-duplicates and low-specificity entries as interactions grow. Inspired by Training-Free GRPO(47)，它通过维护具有添加/删除/修改/保留操作而不是梯度更新的经验知识库来引导冻结策略，我们的第二个贡献是应用相同编辑操作符的LLM内存控制器 - 可选地由, which steers a frozen policy by maintaining an experiential knowledge library with Add/Delete/Modify/Keep operations rather than gradient updates, our second contribution is an LLM memory controller that applies the same edit operators – optionally guided byKK-代理辩论和仲裁者——在优化时期修改推荐经验库。这些组件一起将昂贵的、不频繁的推理压缩过程与廉价的、频繁的检索和排序过程分开。-agent debate and an arbiter – to revise the recommendation experience bank over optimization epochs. Together, these components separate an expensive, infrequent reasoning-compression process from a cheap, frequent retrieval-and-rank process.

我们在 ML-1M、Amazon Beauty 和 Steam 上评估了 10 名 LLM 学生 (3B–20B) 上的 rEDMRec，与零样本、少样本、RAG 和 GraphRAG 进行比较We evaluate rEDMRec on ML-1M, Amazon Beauty, and Steam with ten student LLMs (3B–20B), comparing against zero-shot, few-shot, RAG, and GraphRAG(6)。 rEDMRec 在每个骨干网上相对于零样本、少样本和 RAG 以及大多数骨干网上的 GraphRAG 改进了 HR@1（例外：Llama 3.1 8B 和 GPT OSS 20B），达到 Impv. rEDMRec improves HR@1 over zero-shot, few-shot, and RAG on every backbone, and over GraphRAG on most backbones (exceptions: Llama 3.1 8B and GPT OSS 20B), reaching Impv=13.3%=13.3\%与 RDRec 相对改进协议下 Qwen2.5 3B 上的 GraphRAG 对比vs. GraphRAG on Qwen2.5 3B under the RDRec relative-improvement protocol(41)（节(Section5.1）。渠道消融表明，短期背景是跨能力层唯一持续有用的渠道，而长期、项目感知和反事实效果则依赖于能力（第 1 节）). Channel ablations show that short-term context is the only consistently helpful channel across capacity tiers, whereas long-term, item-perception, and counterfactual effects are capacity-dependent (Section5.2）。一项教师蒸馏研究进一步表明，银行重复率是下游收益的领先指标，受到学生容量的限制。最后，基于辩论的优化减少了银行重复). A teacher-distillation study further shows that bank duplicate rate is a leading indicator of downstream gain, bounded by student capacity. Finally, debate-based optimization lowers bank duplication by7.47.4个百分点，同时将下游 HR@1 提高最多percentage points while raising downstream HR@1 by up to+0.029+0.029超过六个时期，验证控制器作为架构的功能组件（部分over six epochs, validating the controller as a functional component of the architecture (Section5.4).

本文做出以下贡献：This paper makes the following contributions:

  1. 1.

    可编辑的、通道结构的体验记忆An editable, channel-structured experience memory将教师 LLM 推理提炼成四种类型、可独立检索和独立可编辑的通道，而不是单个无差别的推理轨迹（第 1 节）that distills teacher LLM reasoning into four typed, independently retrievable and independently editable channels, rather than a single undifferentiated reasoning trace (Section3.6).

  2. 2.

  3. 3.

2 相关工作Related Work

2.1 基于LLM的推荐LLM-based Recommendation

在 LLM 推荐系统出现之前，神经模型已经对双尺度用户兴趣、评论文本和冷启动评估进行了编码，但它们将该结构存储在参数或语料库中，而不是存储在可编辑的经验库中。顺序新闻推荐器，例如 Co-NAML-LSTURBefore LLM recommenders, neural models already encoded dual-scale user interest, review text, and cold-start evaluation – but they stored that structure in parameters or in the corpus, not in an editable experience bank. Sequential news recommenders such as Co-NAML-LSTUR(26)联合学习具有长期和短期用户表示的多视图项目编码，表明即使没有法学硕士，将持久品味与最近浏览分开也可以提高排名。基于审查的模型，例如 RRSjointly learn multi-view item encodings with long- and short-term user representations, showing that separating durable taste from recent browsing improves ranking even without an LLM. Review-based models such as RRS(27)用基于用户编写的文本的深度编码器替换仅 ID 的协作过滤，因此项目语义通过评论内容而不是通过检索的、键入的内存条目进入排名。补充数据集工作，例如 ViHoRecreplace ID-only collaborative filtering with deep encoders over user-written text, so item semantics enter ranking through review content rather than through a retrieved, typed memory entry. Complementary dataset work such as ViHoRec(29; 28)结果表明，在具有时间冷启动分裂的稀疏越南酒店交互中，邻域方法可以优于针对历史较短的用户学习的潜在因子模型。这些行激发 rEDMRec 存储为通道的相同信号类型 - 长期偏好、短期上下文和项目级文本 - 但它们无法坚持教师生成的推理或在排名失败后添加/删除/修改键入的条目。 rEDMRec 保留了因式分解，但作为冻结学生从中检索的非参数库，而不是作为神经用户/项目塔。shows that, on sparse Vietnamese hotel interactions with a temporal cold-start split, neighborhood methods can outperform learned latent-factor models on users with short histories. These lines motivate the same signal types that rEDMRec stores as channels – long-term preference, short-term context, and item-level text – yet they cannot persist teacher-generated reasoning or Add/Delete/Modify a typed entry after a ranking failure. rEDMRec keeps that factorization, but as a non-parametric bank that a frozen student retrieves from, rather than as a neural user/item tower.

最近的调查将 LLM 推荐器分为提示、调整、协作融合、生成推荐和系统增强范例Recent surveys organize LLM recommenders into prompting, tuning, collaborative fusion, generative recommendation, and system-enhancement paradigms(45; 21; 40; 23; 19)。提示和指令遵循方法将排名视为自然语言生成或零样本排序. Prompting and instruction-following methods cast ranking as natural-language generation or zero-shot ordering(8; 49; 13; 48; 24)，而 TALLRec 和 LLaRA 等对齐框架通过高效的微调使 LLM 适应推荐, while alignment frameworks such as TALLRec and LLaRA adapt LLMs to recommendation with efficient fine-tuning(1; 20)。平行线将协作或 ID 结构注入语言空间 - CoLLM、BinLLM、TokenRec 和相关模型将交互信号编码为类似文本或标记化的表示形式. A parallel line injects collaborative or ID structure into the language space – CoLLM, BinLLM, TokenRec, and related models encode interaction signals as text-like or tokenized representations(53; 52; 33)– 增强方法使用 LLM 进行图形增强、工具使用或围绕经典主干的查询生成– and enhancement methods use LLMs for graph augmentation, tool use, or query generation around a classical backbone(43; 56; 11)。在这些范式中，任何中间推理（如果存在）仍然是短暂的提示上下文或吸收到参数中的知识。相反，rEDMRec 将教师推理具体化为一种非参数的、类型化的记忆，可以在整个课程中保存下来，并且可以在不重新调整学生的情况下进行修改。. Across these paradigms, any intermediate reasoning (when present) remains either ephemeral prompt context or knowledge absorbed into parameters. rEDMRec instead materializes teacher reasoning as a non-parametric, typed memory that survives across sessions and can be revised without re-tuning the student.

2.2 推理、提炼和偏好利用Reasoning, Distillation, and Preference Utilization

更窄的线使LLM推理本身成为设计的对象。推理记录A narrower line makes LLM reasoning itself the object of design. ReasoningRec(2)与法学硕士老师一起综合用户配置文件、项目描述和解释性原理，然后指令调整较小的模型以进行预测和人类可解释的解释——提取然后微调的管道，而不是持久的内存架构。 R2记录synthesizes user profiles, item descriptions, and explanatory rationales with a teacher LLM, then instruction-tunes a smaller model for both prediction and human-interpretable explanation – an extraction-then-fine-tune pipeline rather than a durable memory architecture. R2Rec(55)对交互链进行采样，构建思维交互轨迹，并使用 SFT 和 RL 将其内在化；潜在Rsamples interaction chains, builds interaction-of-thought traces, and internalizes them with SFT and RL; LatentR3 (54)同样强化了模型内部的潜在推理，而 SPRecsimilarly reinforces latent reasoning inside the model, while SPRec(7)使用自我对弈来消除生成推荐系统的偏见。uses self-play to debias generative recommenders.R4R^{4}ec (10)通过将提出偏好/项目知识的参与者与反射模型配对来推动 System-2 审议，该反射模型判断并触发细化，直到知识被认为是合理的，然后将细化的文本注入推荐主干中 - 仍然是每个案例的推理循环，而不是持久的、可编辑的经验库。 RDRec、POD 和 LEADER 等蒸馏工作将基本原理或教师信号压缩为更小的推荐模型pushes toward System-2 deliberation by pairing an actor that proposes preference/item knowledge with a reflection model that judges and triggers refinement until the knowledge is deemed rational, then injects the refined text into a recommendation backbone – still a per-case reasoning loop rather than a persistent, editable experience bank. Distillation work such as RDRec, POD, and LEADER compresses rationales or teacher signals into smaller recommendation models(41; 18; 22)。检索基线（RAG、GraphRAG）在原始历史或图表摘要中的地面排名，无需教师压缩经验. Retrieval baselines (RAG, GraphRAG) ground ranking in raw history or graph summaries without teacher-compressed experience(16; 6)。相对于这些方法，rEDMRec 既不停留在一次性特征利用上，也不将推理冻结为权重：它将推理提炼到具有入门级添加/删除/修改/保留的通道类型库中。. Relative to these methods, rEDMRec neither stops at one-shot feature utilization nor freezes reasoning into weights: it distills reasoning into a channel-typed bank with entry-level Add/Delete/Modify/Keep.

2.3 记忆增强代理和推荐记忆Memory-Augmented Agents and Recommendation Memory

外部存储器允许 LLM 代理在单个上下文窗口之外进行操作。记忆GPTExternal memory lets LLM agents operate beyond a single context window. MemGPT(31)像操作系统虚拟内存管理器一样的页面上下文；生成代理pages context like an OS virtual-memory manager; Generative Agents(32)维护一个检索并反映内存流以实现长范围行为。最接近我们的控制器设计，免培训 GRPOmaintain a retrieve-and-reflect memory stream for long-horizon behavior. Closest to our controller design, Training-Free GRPO(47)通过迭代地将经验知识提炼到通过添加/删除/修改/保留操作更新的非参数库中，改进了冻结的 LLM——这是基于梯度的 GRPO 的免培训替代方案。在推荐中，AutoMR 检索存储的体验以进行生成排名improves a frozen LLM by iteratively distilling experiential knowledge into a non-parametric library updated with Add/Delete/Modify/Keep operations – a training-free alternative to gradient-based GRPO. In recommendation, AutoMR retrieves stored experiences for generative ranking(39)、长期规划者模型耐久品味, long-term planners model durable taste(36)，以及相关工作促使长期利益与短期利益分离, and related work motivates separating long- versus short-term interest(57; 51), 项目级语义, item-level semantics(35; 50), 硬负对比度, hard-negative contrast(37; 17)，以及用户可控的配置文件, and user-controllable profiles(44)。这些设计检索历史记录、个人资料或通用特工痕迹；它们不是由教师提炼的四渠道推荐经验和辩论驱动的银行维护来组织的。 rEDMRec 采用免训练 GRPO 原则，即编辑外部经验库而不是模型权重，但将模式专门用于推荐信号类型，并将每个通道与匹配存储配对（向量与混合图向量）。. These designs retrieve history, profiles, or generic agent traces; they are not organized as teacher-distilled, four-channel recommendation experience with debate-driven bank maintenance. rEDMRec adopts the Training-Free GRPO principle of editing an external experience library instead of model weights, but specializes the schema to recommendation signal types and pairs each channel with a matching store (vector vs. hybrid graph–vector).

2.4 多智能体辩论与自我完善Multi-Agent Debate and Self-Refinement

迭代批评改进了 LLM 输出，无需额外的监督标签。自我完善Iterative critique improves LLM outputs without additional supervised labels. Self-Refine(25)让模型根据自我反馈修改自己的文本；多主体辩论has a model revise its own text from self-feedback; multiagent debate(5)通过多个实例提出和批评答案来提高事实性；并在推荐中，improves factuality by having several instances propose and critique answers; and in recommendation,R4R^{4}ec (10)将参与者和反射模型结合起来，以在主干预测之前完善偏好/项目知识。这些行评估单个工件（每个案例的一个答案、一份文档或一个知识字符串），并且不会衡量不断增长的集合的重复细化如何影响银行规模的重复积累或检索质量。 rEDMRec 对经验库进行批评和修改：couples actor and reflection models to refine preference/item knowledge before backbone prediction. These lines evaluate a single artifact – one answer, one document, or one knowledge string per case – and do not measure how repeated refinement of a growing collection affects duplicate accumulation or retrieval quality at bank scale. rEDMRec applies critique-and-revise to the experience bank:KK辩论角色批评案例，仲裁者综合修订，控制者提交添加/删除/修改/保留操作，银行级重复率和特异性与下游 HR@1 相关联（第 1 节）debating personas critique a case, an arbiter synthesizes revisions, and the controller commits Add/Delete/Modify/Keep operations, with bank-level duplicate rate and specificity linked to downstream HR@1 (Section5.4).

推理提取（Reasoning extraction (reas\mathrm{reas}).运行一个五步思想链，识别喜欢的项目之间的共同主题，对每个候选者进行评分，对比前两个候选者，并提出最终建议；它的摘要字段也路由到Runs a five-step chain-of-thought that identifies shared themes across liked items, scores each candidate against them, contrasts the top two candidates, and states a final recommendation; its summary field also routes toip\mathrm{ip}, 补充, complementingctx\mathrm{ctx}具有明确的比较原理，而不是每个项目的描述。with an explicit comparative rationale rather than a per-item description.

反事实提取（Counterfactual extraction (cf\mathrm{cf}).给定一个锚点（选择的）项目和一个对比（硬阴性）项目，产生为什么首选/为什么拒绝的基本原理以及对比项目将超越锚点的假设条件；完全路由至通道Given an anchor (chosen) item and a contrast (hard-negative) item, produces why-preferred / why-rejected rationales and a hypothetical condition under which the contrast item would outrank the anchor; routes entirely to channelcf\mathrm{cf}作为图形边缘（部分as a graph edge (Section3.6.2).

4.1 数据集Datasets

我们对涵盖显式-隐式反馈范围的三个推荐数据集进行评估。We evaluate on three recommendation datasets that span the explicit-implicit feedback spectrum.ML-1M (12)提供 1-5 星的明确评级，是基于 LLM 的推荐的标准基准。provides 1–5 star explicit ratings and is a standard benchmark for LLM-based recommendation.亚马逊美容Amazon Beauty (30)提供明确的评级和评论文本，但每个用户的数量大大减少，这强调了记忆库补偿微弱协作信号的能力。provides explicit ratings and review text but is substantially sparser per user, which stresses the memory bank’s ability to compensate for weak collaborative signal.蒸汽Steam (15)是一个is an隐式反馈implicit-feedback数据集：它记录用户玩过哪些游戏，而不是明确的评分，因此每个记录的交互都被视为同等加权的积极信号（评分固定为dataset: it logs which games a user played rather than an explicit rating, so every logged interaction is treated as an equally-weighted positive signal (rating fixed to1.01.0, 正阈值, positive threshold0.00.0）而不是根据分级评级量表设定阈值。对于所有三个数据集，我们应用) instead of being thresholded from a graded rating scale. 我们考虑了对优秀学生的逆号的三种非排他性解释，按照我们可以使用当前仪器的证据的降序排列。首先，We consider three, non-exclusive explanations for the reversed sign on strong students, in decreasing order of the evidence we can bring to bear with the current instrumentation. First,通道冗余channel redundancy：长期偏好陈述通常会重述提示的原始历史记录块中已经存在的信息，因此，已经很好地关注原始历史记录的优秀学生不会获得任何额外的收益，而是为冗余文本付出了少量的“分心”成本。第二，: long-term preference statements often restate information already present in the raw history block of the prompt, so a strong student that already attends well to raw history gains nothing extra and instead pays a small “distraction” cost for the redundant text. Second,通用的、低特异性的条目generic, low-specificity entries：在银行生命周期早期产生的项目感知条目往往很长并且可操作性不强（第: item-perception entries produced early in the bank’s lifecycle tend to be long and only loosely actionable (Section5.5通过特异性分数直接量化这一点）。三、quantifies this directly via a specificity score). Third,相互矛盾的信号conflicting signals：当假设条件部分匹配当前用户时，反事实边缘可以将看似合理但最终不正确的候选者推到真实目标之上。只有中等能力的学生，他们还无法在没有原始历史帮助的情况下提取相同的信息，才能无条件地从反事实渠道中受益；事实上，这种效应的迹象取决于学生的能力，而不是固定的，这一事实本身就证明了反对将任何单一渠道视为普遍有用或普遍有害。图: a counterfactual edge can push a plausible but ultimately incorrect candidate above the true target when its hypothetical condition partially matches the current user. Only the mid-capacity student, which cannot yet extract the same information unaided from raw history, benefits from the counterfactual channel unconditionally; the fact that the sign of this effect depends on student capacity, rather than being fixed, is itself evidence against treating any single channel as universally useful or harmful. Figure4显示了这种模式适用于消融面板中的所有七个主干，并且图shows this pattern holds across all seven backbones in the ablation panel, and Figure5显示反向通道翻转符号为shows that the reversed channels flip sign as the银行bank从稀疏岸锚增长（grows from the sparse-bank anchor (B=189B{=}189) 朝向) toward10510^{5}–10610^{6}条目，因为更密集的银行会稀释驱动小逆转的冗余和通用条目entries, because a denser bank dilutes the redundant and generic entries that drive the reversal at smallBB（库大小独立于第 5 节中的完整测试评估协议(bank size is independent of the full-test evaluation protocol in Section4.4）。每骨干网). Together, these two tables support a causal chain in which teacher quality first improves bank quality (lower duplication), and bank quality only converts into downstream gain up to a ceiling set by the student’s own capacity to use additional bank detail.

5.5 定性案例研究：记忆条目如何演变？Qualitative Case Study: How Do Memory Entries Evolve?

上面的消融和辩论优化结果是聚合信号；为了使机制具体化，我们使用确定性的、无法学硕士的特异性得分（特异性将具体性、流派术语覆盖率、词汇多样性和对冲语言惩罚结合成一个单一的值）直接比较每个内存通道中每个用户最早和最新的持久条目The ablation and debate-optimization results above are aggregate signals; to make the mechanism concrete, we directly compare the earliest and the latest persisted entry per user in each memory channel, using a deterministic, LLM-free specificity score (specificity combines concreteness, genre-term coverage, lexical diversity, and a hedge-language penalty into a single[0,1][0,1]分数，没有额外的 LLM 电话）。表score, with no additional LLM calls). Table10总结了至少有两个持久版本的用户之间产生的前后增量。四个渠道中的三个在培训过程中变得更加具体，更少的对冲；项目感知通道变化最大（平均特异性summarizes the resulting before/after deltas across users with at least two persisted versions. Three of the four channels become more specific and less hedged over training; the item-perception channel changes the most (mean specificity0.405→0.4880.405\rightarrow 0.488），从通用的后备语言转向基于项目的、可操作的陈述。短期上下文通道是个例外：它的平均特异性), moving from generic fallback language to item-grounded, actionable statements. The short-term context channel is the exception: its mean specificity减少decreases稍微（slightly (0.433→0.4010.433\rightarrow 0.401），其中图), which Figure8下面的案例显示的不是质量回归，而是压缩效应——冗长的叙述条目被简短的、有条件的“会话规则”所取代，这些“会话规则”的结构在词汇上的多样性较少，但学生可以更直接地采取行动。and the cases below show is not a quality regression but a compression effect – verbose narrative entries are replaced by short, conditional “session rules” that are less lexically diverse by construction but more directly actionable by the student.

表Table11之前展示了三个代表shows three representative before→\to从持久存储库中提取对后（一对长期，一对项目感知，一对短期）。after pairs drawn from the persisted bank (one long-term, one item-perception, one short-term).案例ACase A（长期，用户 2）将单部电影对冲（“数据非常有限……”）替换为可用于排名的口味声明，其中命名了时代、特许经营类型和权重规则，从而提高了特定性(long-term, user 2) replaces a single-film hedge (“Very limited data…”) with a ranking-ready taste statement that names era, franchise type, and an upweight rule, lifting specificity from0.2140.214 to 0.4790.479. 案例BCase B（项目感知，用户 4）将模糊的 Hit@1 投诉转换为基于项目的规则，该规则的关键是(item-perception, user 4) converts a vague Hit@1 complaint into an item-grounded rule keyed to洛奇 (1976)Rocky (1976)，具有明确的, with an explicit+30+30–50%50\%抢七局提升 – 最大的单场比赛tie-break boost – the largest single-entryΔ\Delta规格在样本中（Spec. in the sample (+0.500+0.500). 案例CCase C（短期，用户 2）说明了负均值背后的压缩模式(short-term, user 2) illustrates the compression pattern behind the negative meanΔ\Delta在该渠道上：空的“无新兴利益”注释成为具有多样性限制的简短会议规则；相对于长篇叙事条目，词汇多样性有所下降，但可操作性却有所上升。这三个案例共同表明，辩论驱动的添加/修改操作不仅仅是解释条目，它们还将确认的信号积累到更短、更具体、面向排名的内存中。on that channel: an empty “no emerging interests” note becomes a short session rule with diversity constraints; lexical diversity drops relative to long narrative entries, but actionability rises. Together the three cases show that debate-driven Add/Modify operations do not merely paraphrase entries – they accumulate confirmed signals into shorter, more specific, ranking-oriented memory.

6 讨论和限制Discussion and Limitations

工作点概括。Operating-point generalization.银行规模分析（第The bank-scale analysis (Section5.2）和) and thekk-EPOCH 和代理数量曲线（部分-EPOCH and number-of-agents curves (Section5.4）跨越广泛的设置 - 银行规模高达) span a wide range of settings – bank sizes up to10610^{6}条目、最多 6 个辩论纪元和最多 10 名辩论代理人。实践者采用特定的操作点（例如，特定的entries, up to six debate epochs, and up to ten debating agents. A practitioner adopting a specific operating point (for example, a specifickk-生产系统中的EPOCH预算或银行规模）应该重新确认该确切点的行为，因为在一定范围内测量的趋势并不能保证在每个中间设置下都有相同的行为。-EPOCH budget or bank size) in a production system should re-confirm behavior at that exact point, since a trend measured across a range does not guarantee identical behavior at every intermediate setting.

教师覆盖。Teacher coverage.主要结果（节The main results (Section5.1）将老师固定为) fix the teacher toGPT-5.4-迷你gpt-5.4-mini;教师蒸馏研究（第; the teacher-distillation study (Section5.3）改变老师，但只针对两个固定的学生。我们还没有测量完整的老师) varies the teacher but only against two fixed students. We have not measured the full teacher×\times学生的叉积，因此是否观察到教师质量效应仍然悬而未决student cross-product, so it remains open whether the teacher-quality effect observed forGPT-5-迷你gpt-5-miniQwen2.5 3B 在表中的所有 10 名学生中一致成立and Qwen2.5 3B holds uniformly across all ten students in Table12.

解释忠实。Explanation faithfulness.rEDMRec 的学生可以根据检索到的记忆发出简短的解释（第rEDMRec’s student can emit a short explanation grounded in retrieved memory (Section3.7），但本文评估的是排名质量，而不是所给出的解释是否忠实于其引用的记忆；正如我们的评估计划中概述的那样，对解释真实性和合理性的人工评估将留给未来的工作。), but this paper evaluates ranking quality, not whether the emitted explanation is faithful to the memory it cites; a human evaluation of explanation faithfulness and plausibility, as outlined in our evaluation plan, is left to future work.

依赖骨干的回报。Backbone-dependent returns.该架构假设学生可以遵循中等复杂的提示，该提示将用户上下文、候选描述和检索到的记忆片段连接起来。部分The architecture assumes the student can follow a moderately complex prompt that concatenates user context, candidate descriptions, and retrieved memory snippets. Section5.1表明这一假设至少在一个主干网络 (Llama 3.1 8B) 上不成立，我们将其负 Impv 与 GraphRAG 归因于指令遵循较弱，而不是原则上内存无用；接近饱和的 20B 参数学生同样略微落后于 GraphRAG。记忆仍然使每个学生超越零样本/少样本/RAG，但并不总是超过 GraphRAG – 附录shows this assumption breaks down for at least one backbone (Llama 3.1 8B), whose negative Impv vs. GraphRAG we attribute to weak instruction-following rather than to the memory being unhelpful in principle; the near-saturated 20B-parameter student likewise trails GraphRAG slightly. Memory still lifts every student over Zero-shot/Few-shot/RAG, but not always over GraphRAG – AppendixK将这些故障单元和边界控制器编辑制成表格。实际上，rEDMRec 增加的系统复杂性对于中小型学生来说价值最高。tabulates these failure cells and borderline controller edits. Practically, the value of rEDMRec’s added system complexity is highest for small-to-mid capacity students.

域范围。Domain scope.我们的三个数据集涵盖了带有英语元数据的电影、美容产品和游戏推荐；我们还没有测试具有显着不同的项目描述结构（例如，短视频或新闻推荐）的领域，并且四通道模式，特别是反事实通道，是根据具有稳定、可比较属性的目录项目设计的。Our three datasets cover movie, beauty-product, and game recommendation with English-language metadata; we have not tested domains with substantially different item-description structure (e.g., short-video or news recommendation), and the four-channel schema, in particular the counterfactual channel, was designed with catalog items that have stable, comparable attributes in mind.

7 结论Conclusion

本文提出了 rEDMRec，解决了跨推荐请求重用（而不是重复）LLM 推理的问题，rEDMRec 是一种架构，可将教师推理提炼成四通道、可编辑的经验记忆，并为仅从该记忆中检索的轻量级学生的排名请求提供服务。关键思想是将不频繁、昂贵的推理压缩过程（教师提取、蒸馏和基于辩论的内存优化）与频繁、廉价的推理过程分开，从而将推荐质量与每个请求的推理成本分离。在十个学生 LLM 和三个数据集上，此设计在每个骨干网上比零样本、少样本和 RAG 改进了 HR@1、NDCG 和 MRR，在大多数骨干网上比 GraphRAG（例外：Llama 3.1 8B 和 GPT OSS 20B）进行了改进，对于最小的学生，具有最大的 RDRec 式 Impv (%) 与第二最佳基线；我们的渠道消融、教师蒸馏和辩论优化研究进一步表明，短期环境是跨能力层级唯一持续有益的渠道（长期、项目感知和反事实影响取决于能力），银行重复是下游增益达到学生能力上限的领先指标，并且This paper addresses the problem of reusing, rather than repeating, LLM reasoning across recommendation requests, by proposing rEDMRec, an architecture that distills teacher reasoning into a four-channel, editable experience memory and serves ranking requests from a lightweight student that only retrieves from this memory. The key idea is to separate an infrequent, expensive reasoning-compression process – teacher extraction, distillation, and debate-based memory optimization – from a frequent, cheap inference process, which decouples recommendation quality from per-request reasoning cost. Across ten student LLMs and three datasets, this design improves HR@1, NDCG, and MRR over zero-shot, few-shot, and RAG on every backbone, and over GraphRAG on most backbones (exceptions: Llama 3.1 8B and GPT OSS 20B), with the largest RDRec-style Impv (%) vs. the second-best baseline on the smallest students; our channel-ablation, teacher-distillation, and debate-optimization studies further show that short-term context is the only consistently beneficial channel across capacity tiers (with long-term, item-perception, and counterfactual effects capacity-dependent), that bank duplication is a leading indicator of downstream gain up to a student-capacity ceiling, and thatKK-代理辩论显着提高了银行质量，其方式是传播排名准确性而不是表面改进。其余的限制包括不完整的教师-agent debate measurably improves bank quality in a way that propagates into ranking accuracy rather than being a cosmetic refinement. Remaining limitations include incomplete teacher×\times学生的覆盖范围和缺乏对解释忠实度的人为评估（第student coverage and the lack of a human evaluation of explanation faithfulness (Section6）；缩小这些差距是将 rEDMRec 部署为生产推荐系统的重要的下一步。); closing those gaps is an important next step toward deploying rEDMRec as a production recommendation system.

附录KAppendix K失败案例和定性内存编辑Failure Cases and Qualitative Memory Edits

本附录补充了第 5 节中的积极定性案例This appendix complements the positive qualitative cases in Section5.5以及附录中的端到端跟踪and the end-to-end traces in AppendixJ与with失效模式failure modes和and边界编辑borderline edits：输给 GraphRAG 的主干，过于激进地重写品味的控制器编辑，以及降低词汇特异性同时保持可操作性的短期压缩模式。: backbones that lose to GraphRAG, controller edits that rewrite taste too aggressively, and the short-term compression pattern that lowers lexical specificity while remaining actionable.

H.1 与 GraphRAG 的排名失败。H.1 Ranking failures vs. GraphRAG.

在 ML-1M 上，rEDMRec 在 Llama 3.1 8B 上落后于 GraphRAG（ImpvOn ML-1M, rEDMRec trails GraphRAG on Llama 3.1 8B (Impv=−11.1%=-11.1\%）和 GPT OSS 20B（Impv) and GPT OSS 20B (Impv=−3.3%=-3.3\%;附录; AppendixA）。我们将 Llama 失败归因于串联内存提示上的弱指令跟踪（第 1 节）). We attribute the Llama failure to weak instruction-following on the concatenated memory prompt (Section6），而不是空银行：同一家银行对实力较强的学生产生正的 Impv。在 Beauty/Steam 上，相同的两个主干再次显示接近零或负的 Impv（附录), not to an empty bank: the same bank yields positive Impv on stronger students. On Beauty/Steam the same two backbones again show near-zero or negative Impv (AppendixB–C），因此限制是依赖于主干网的，而不是特定于数据集的。), so the limitation is backbone-dependent rather than dataset-specific.

H.2 定性编辑：成功与风险。H.2 Qualitative edits: success vs. risk.

表Table26对比有益的长期重写（案例 S1；也是正文中的案例 A），contrasts a beneficial long-term rewrite (Case S1; also Case A in the main text), a味觉翻转taste-flip存在辩论用黑色/犯罪（案例 R1）、短期压缩（案例 C1）和强烈基于项目的项目感知修复（案例 S2）覆盖早期科幻简介的风险。risk where debate overwrites an earlier sci-fi profile with noir/crime (Case R1), short-term compression (Case C1), and a strongly item-grounded item-perception fix (Case S2).

H.3 容量相关的信道反转。H.3 Capacity-dependent channel reversals.

通道消融（部分Channel ablations (Section5.2）表明消除长期记忆、项目感知或反事实记忆可以) show that removing long-term, item-perception, or counterfactual memory can改善improveHR@1 最强消融组学生（HR@1 on the strongest ablation-panel student (GPT-5-迷你gpt-5-mini），即当骨干已经在候选人中排名很高时，银行可以注入噪音。短期环境仍然是跨层唯一持续有益的渠道——这是针对饱和学生的“始终检索所有四个渠道”部署的实际失败模式。), i.e. the bank can inject noise when the backbone already ranks well from candidates alone. Short-term context remains the only consistently beneficial channel across tiers — a practical failure mode for “always retrieve all four channels” deployments on saturated students.
